name: Role-based access for staff and admin
description: The system must support distinct permissions for principals, teachers, admin staff, and support roles so sensitive academic and student information is handled appropriately.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks who can view or edit student records.
Developer asks about teacher or admin permissions.
Developer mentions auditability or restricted data access.

name: Student record and enrollment management
description: The system must store student profiles, enrollment records, and academic history while keeping records consistent over time.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about student profiles or enrollment data.
Developer mentions academic history or records continuity.
Developer asks how records are updated over time.

name: Attendance and performance tracking
description: The school needs a way to record attendance, monitor academic performance, and track patterns that might require action.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about attendance or grade tracking.
Developer mentions performance monitoring or student follow-up.
Developer discusses data for academic decisions.

name: Timetable, class, and teacher scheduling
description: The solution must manage class schedules, room assignments, and teacher coverage without creating confusion or gaps.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about timetable creation or class scheduling.
Developer mentions room or teacher assignments.
Developer discusses scheduling conflicts or coverage rules.

name: Fee collection and billing workflows
description: The school needs payments, fee tracking, and reminders so fees, invoices, and overdue balances are managed clearly.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about school fees or payment collection.
Developer mentions invoicing or overdue balances.
Developer discusses billing workflows or reminders.

name: Reporting and school operations dashboards
description: The school needs reports for attendance, academic performance, enrollment trends, and operational KPIs that support decisions by leadership.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or managerial reporting.
Developer mentions attendance, enrollment, or performance trends.
Developer discusses operational visibility for leaders.

name: Parent and communication workflows
description: The system may need to support parent communication, notifications, and basic record-sharing without creating unnecessary complexity.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about parent communication or notifications.
Developer mentions messages or reminders.
Developer discusses communication between school and families.

name: Operational constraints and system integrations
description: The solution must work with real school processes, likely with current admin tools, low staff training burden, and limited office disruption during term time.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about integrating with current tools.
Developer mentions training burden or staff adoption.
Developer discusses operational constraints during busy academic periods.

name: Exam and assessment workflow support
description: The school may need to support assessment schedules, exam records, and grade publication in a structured and auditable way.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about exams or assessment tracking.
Developer mentions grade publication or academic records.
Developer discusses formal assessment processes.
